name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: "1.24.x"
      - name: Cross-build
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o /dev/null ./...
          GOOS=plan9 GOARCH=amd64 go build -o /dev/null ./...
